title: "PRISM" Is Not All You Need: Cross-Topic Name Collisions and Scientific Paper Retrieval
author: Jingjie Ning, Xueqi Li, Yibo Kong
description: Scientific names increasingly connect papers from different research topics, leaving readers to recover a paper's identity from context. We study this convergence in 564,861 AI-related arXiv records. Cross-topic name collision grows 4.33-fold from a pooled 2020-2022 reference to 2026, compared with 1.12-fold within…
summary: Scientific names increasingly connect papers from different research topics, leaving readers to recover a paper's identity from context. We study this convergence in 564,861 AI-related arXiv records.
takeaways: We study this convergence in 564,861 AI-related arXiv records.
The evaluation separates candidate competition, document fields, and contextual ranking through lexical, dense, and language-model baselines.
Source-linked cases and a portable evaluation collection make the phenomenon inspectable and reusable for scientific retrieval and research assistants.
